text: (Excited and enthusiastic, conveying delight and wonder. Lively rising intonation and emphatic delivery, without shouting.)En mil quinientos sesenta y uno, Felipe segundo instaló la corte en Madrid. Aquella decisión dio al viejo palacio un papel central y abrió una larga etapa de reformas.
voiceDescription: Excited and enthusiastic, conveying delight and wonder. Lively rising intonation and emphatic delivery, without shouting.
